# Municipal Ordinance No. 10, Series of 2008

**Traffic Citation Ticket Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance establishes a traffic citation ticket system for violations of traffic ordinances in Pitogo, Quezon. It defines traffic violations, outlines procedures for issuing tickets, and sets penalties for non-compliance. The ordinance aims to improve traffic management and ensure public safety within the municipality.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Title - This ordinance shall be known as Traffic Citation Ticket Ordinance of 2008.
2.  **Section 2.** Scope - This ordinance shall apply to all drivers, owners and operators of public and privately-owned motor vehicles such as tricycles, jeepneys, automobiles, trucks, buses and other motor vehicles operating within the territorial jurisdiction of Pitogo, Quezon.
3.  **Section 3.** Definition - Defines terms such as Traffic Violation, Driver, Operator, Owner, Mayor, Traffic Citation Ticket.
4.  **Section 4.** Guidelines - Outlines guidelines for traffic officers, including seminar attendance, issuance of citation tickets, and proper procedure for handling violations.
5.  **Section 5.** Failure of traffic officer to comply with the provisions of Sec. 4 shall make him liable for appropriate administrative disciplinary action.
6.  **Section 6.** Voluntary Payment - Within seventy two (72) hours from his receipt of the original copy of the citation ticket, the violator may select in lieu of prosecution, to voluntarily pay the corresponding fine provided herein.
7.  **Section 7.** Nothing licensee herein, shall be construed to authorize the traffic officer to confiscate the drivers license and to remove the vehicle plate, except when it shall be used as evidence for other types of offenses.
8.  **Section 8.** Penalties - If the violator is prosecuted as provided for in Sec. 5 hereof for violation of the ordinance and is subsequently convicted by a competent court of jurisdiction, he shall be penalized with a fine of One Thousand Pesos (P 1,000.00) or imprisonment of not more than 6 days or both at the discretion of the court.
9.  **Section 9.** Reckoning Period - The reckoning period for traffic offenses is one year at the start of the new year. A new reckoning period begins January to December of the year.
10. **Section 10.** Reportorial Clause - the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] in its legislative power direct the FNP to strictly enforce/implement this ordinance without fear or favor and submit their monthly accomplishment report direct to the [[Sangguniang Bayan]], furnished to the Municipal Mayor for his information.
11. **Section 11.** Effectivity - This Ordinance shall take effect pursuant to [[Sec-511-RA7160|Sec. 511]] of [[RA-7160|Republic Act 7160]] otherwise known as the new Local Government Code of 1991.
